name: Lantern
author: InfantGodIDE examples
description: The worked example mod written for this repository: two yarn nodes and five spoken lines carrying the whole tag surface, a base translation table plus an English one, a character wired to portraits and a spine stub, a character state, a pixel animation with bone and physics tracks, a song and a voice-over definition over two small PCM WAVs, four sprites (one of them 8-bit RGB) and four attachments (one of them deliberately pointing at a sprite that is not here). Nothing in this package is copied from the game's own mods.
